app.title: Bring List
install.title: Install Mitbringliste
validation.email: Please enter a valid email address.
validation.rate_limit: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
event.creator_email_hint: The list works fine without an e-mail address, but you won't receive any notifications (e.g. when someone claims an item). You can add it later any time via 'Edit Event'.
event.no_email_modal_text: Without an e-mail address, all notifications are disabled — including the ones you configured below (e.g. on new claim or when the list is complete). You can add your e-mail address later any time via 'Edit Event'.
event.no_email_modal_back: Go back and enter e-mail address
event.guest_sees_names: Guests can see who claimed what
event.notify_on_complete: Email notification when list is complete
event.auto_delete_hint: No date set: deletion starts from today. With date: deletion occurs N days after the event.
event.access_password_hint: 4-50 characters. Doesn't need to be complex — it just keeps casual passers-by from viewing the link. Leave blank = no password protection.
event.access_password_hint_edit: 4-50 characters. Leave blank to keep the current password.
event.admin_link_warning: Save your admin link now! It is your only access to manage this event and cannot be recovered.
event.no_items: No items yet. Add the first one!
event.danger_zone_hint: The event will be permanently deleted, along with all items, claims and suggestions. Both links (management and guest) will stop working afterwards.
event.delete_confirm: Really permanently delete "{title}" and all its items and claims? This cannot be undone.
event.gift_mode_description: Claimed gifts will be hidden from other guests to keep the surprise.
item.name: Item Name
item.confirm_delete: Really delete this item? All claims will be deleted too.
item.reorder_failed: Failed to save the new order.
claim.success: Great! Your claim has been saved.
claim.success_notify_hint: The event creator will be notified by e-mail in about {minutes} minutes — you can still change your mind until then.
claim.already_claimed: This item has already been fully claimed.
claim.limit_reached: The requested quantity exceeds the available amount.
claim.race_condition: This item was just claimed by someone else. Please try again.
claim.gift_mode_email_label: Notify me when all spots are filled (optional)
claim.gift_mode_email_consent: Your email will only be used for this notification and deleted immediately afterwards.
claim.undo_notified_hint: The other participants have already been notified. Please let them know directly.
claim.undo_confirm_notified: The other participants may already have been notified by email. Undo the claim anyway?
claim.undo_creator_notified_hint: The event creator has already been notified by e-mail. Please let them know directly.
claim.undo_confirm_creator_notified: The event creator has already been notified by e-mail. Undo the claim anyway?
guest.title: What's needed?
guest.suggest_description: Something missing from the list? Suggest it — the organiser can then approve it.
guest.suggest_success: Your suggestion has been submitted and is awaiting approval.
guest.no_items_available: No items available at this time.
guest.gift_mode_all_claimed: All items have already been claimed. Thanks to everyone who signed up!
guest.event_expired: This event is no longer available.
guest.locked_desc: This list is password-protected. Please enter the password to continue.
guest.event_expired_desc: The link is no longer valid. The event was automatically deleted or is no longer active.
admin.delete_event_confirm: Really delete event "{title}" and all its items and claims?
admin.brute_force: Too many failed attempts. Please wait {minutes} minutes.
admin.rate_limits_desc: Defines how many failed attempts or actions are allowed before a temporary block is applied.
admin.claim_delay_desc: How long a guest has to undo a claim before the notification e-mail is sent to the event creator. Applies to new claims from now on; windows already in progress are unaffected.
admin.cron_manual_desc: Immediately deletes all events whose individual retention period (set when the event was created, default 30 days after the event date) has passed, plus rate-limit entries older than 24 hours.
admin.cron_run_result: {events} expired event(s) and {rate_limit} rate-limit entr(y/ies) deleted.
admin.cron_webcron_inactive_desc: With a security token, cleanup can also be triggered automatically via a free web-cron service (e.g. cron-job.org) — no login or SSH access needed.
admin.cron_webcron_active_desc: Have a web-cron service call this URL regularly (e.g. daily) to automatically clean up events and rate-limit entries.
admin.cron_url_hint: This URL contains a secret token and replaces username/password. Do not share it.
admin.cron_tab_desc: For servers with direct SSH access: add this entry to the crontab to run the cleanup automatically every day.
admin.cron_tab_php_hint: If the PHP path on your server differs (e.g. /usr/local/bin/php8.2), replace 'php' accordingly.
admin.cron_regenerate_confirm: Generate a new token? The current URL will stop working immediately.
admin.cron_disable_confirm: Really disable web-cron access? The call URL will stop working afterwards.
admin.cron_token_generated: Token generated. The call URL is shown below.
admin.passkey_not_supported: Your browser does not support passkeys.
admin.passkey_name_hint: Give your passkey a descriptive name so you can identify it later.
admin.passkey_login_hint: You have one or more passkeys registered. Click below to sign in.
admin.recovery_no_2fa: Recovery codes become available once you enable TOTP or add a passkey.
admin.recovery_new_hint: These codes are shown only once. Write them down or store them safely — they are your only emergency access.
admin.recovery_regenerate_confirm: Invalidate all existing recovery codes and generate new ones?
admin.recovery_regenerated: New emergency recovery codes have been generated.
admin.design_contrast_warning: Low contrast ({ratio}:1) between this color and white button text. At least 4.5:1 is recommended for good readability.
admin.design_default_language_hint: Used when visitors haven't explicitly chosen a language.
admin.design_license_url_hint: Optional. Leave blank: text is shown as plain text. With a URL: text becomes a link (opens in a new tab).
